name: Marked by War
description: Combat has left its mark on you in ways both physical and spiritual — you are at your best when the fighting is fiercest.
effect: +4 Strength and +4 Fortitude at character creation.
ai_instruction: Add 4 to character Strength and 4 to character Fortitude during character creation. Narrate as a warrior's body and spirit forged by conflict — most alive in the heat of battle.
